body.message: Thank you so much for the beautiful and well-kept place. I’m sure this won’t be our last stay here and I’ll definitely recommend it to my friends. Honestly, I’m surprised the place doesn’t have a higher rating, it’s very nice, clean, well organized, in a great location, and you’ve been very welcoming and helpful throughout our stay. As agreed, I’ll check out at 2 PM and I’ll leave the keys for you and send you a photo of where I’ve placed them. Thank you again
